import sys

MOD = 998244353
INV2 = 499122177

def compute(l, r, cells):
    k = r - l
    even = k // 2 + 1
    odd = (k + 1) // 2
    if cells % 2 == 1:
        return str(pow(k + 1, cells, MOD))
    else:
        temp1 = pow(even + odd, cells, MOD)
        temp2 = pow(even - odd, cells, MOD)
        sum_ = (temp1 + temp2) % MOD
        ans = (sum_ * INV2) % MOD
        return str(ans)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, m, l, r = map(int, data[:4])
    cells = n * m
    result = compute(l, r, cells)
    if cells % 2 == 1:
        sys.stdout.write(result)
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(result + '\n')
    sys.stdout.flush()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
